articles.summary: Ángela Elena Olazarán Laureano, a 17-year-old Mexican student who developed an AI-powered virtual medical assistant and advocates for girls to pursue STEM careers, has been named the winner of the Chegg.org Global Student Prize 2024.
articles.title: 17-year-old Mexican prodigy Ángela Elena Olazarán Laureano wins $100,000 Chegg.org Global Student Prize 2024
